authentic_qa.label: Authentic question → answer
authentic_qa.availability: Existing paired fields; candidate for supervised adaptation after source and quality review.
input: history: only turns preceding this answer
authentic_qa.inference: At inference: supply the date, role and a new question; generate an answer. During SFT, supervise only the recorded answer. Do not place the answer in the prompt.
authentic_qa.scoring: Evidence-based review of accuracy, attribution and substantive policy content. No automatic verifier or RL environment supplied.
authentic_qa.possible_use: SFT or supervised distillation; useful baseline for a country-conditioned adapter.

press_conference.label: Full conference document
press_conference.availability: Source document; individual Q&A extraction exists for part of this source.
input: earlier turns only, if constructing a dialogue
target: A selected answer span after extraction; not the entire transcript by default
press_conference.inference: At inference: generate the next answer given earlier context. Full-document continued pretraining is a separate option with text loss, not a prompt/completion trace.
press_conference.scoring: Check speaker segmentation and event/translation splits; exclude future answers from context.
press_conference.possible_use: Extract Q&A for SFT; optional continued pretraining after cleaning.

statement_reconstruction.label: Statement / speech reconstruction
statement_reconstruction.availability: Observed statement text; an instruction may be constructed from metadata.
input: title / agenda and context, when present
statement_reconstruction.inference: At inference: request a statement on an agenda with dated evidence. Reconstructing a historical speech is a supervised proxy, not observed negotiation behavior.
statement_reconstruction.scoring: Review speaker, policy fidelity and unsupported commitments. No reward verifier or transition model exists.
statement_reconstruction.possible_use: Statement SFT, retrieval evidence, or optional domain-text training.

vote_label_only.label: Recorded vote label
vote_label_only.availability: Action label exists; proposal text is generally missing.
input: MISSING for most rows: actual proposal and contemporaneous context
vote_label_only.inference: Potential inference task: predict a vote on a supplied proposal. Join the proposal first; the identifier alone is not adequate decision context.
vote_label_only.scoring: Exact-match scoring is possible only after validating labels and proposal joins. A correct historical vote does not verify a generated explanation.
vote_label_only.possible_use: Classification / SFT after joining context; possible offline verifiable task, not an existing RLVR environment.

vote_prediction.label: Proposal → recorded vote
vote_prediction.availability: Sample has question/context fields and a recorded vote; validate joins and historical leakage.
vote_prediction.inference: At inference: generate one vote label for the supplied proposal. Keep post-vote statements out of forecasting inputs.
vote_prediction.scoring: Exact match to the recorded label, after verifying final versus procedural votes. No inference about hidden motives.
vote_prediction.possible_use: Label SFT or evaluation; a candidate for an offline verifier, not a prepared RL rollout environment.

upr_recommendation.label: Recommendation from one state to another
upr_recommendation.availability: Recommendation text and directed state roles exist; earlier review context may be incomplete.
input: question / prior review evidence when available
upr_recommendation.inference: At inference: generate a recommendation for the reviewed state. Do not reverse the recommending and reviewed roles.
upr_recommendation.scoring: Check attribution and recommendation grounding; no automatic quality reward is supplied.
upr_recommendation.possible_use: Directed recommendation SFT or retrieval evidence.

upr_response.label: Recommendation → reviewed-state response
upr_response.availability: Question contains recommendation; text contains the response label.
target: text: response such as Supported or Noted
upr_response.inference: At inference: predict a response label for a recommendation. A noted response is not proof of implementation or a private preference.
upr_response.scoring: Potential exact-match label check, subject to response-date and linkage validation; no reward implementation bundled.
upr_response.possible_use: Response classification / SFT; possible offline verifiable task after validation.

human_rights_evidence.label: Institutional human-rights evidence
human_rights_evidence.availability: Text from a monitoring mechanism, not necessarily the country’s own voice.
input: text as retrieved evidence, with document and institutional author
reviewed country, dates and role metadata
target: No ground-truth country answer is present in this record
human_rights_evidence.inference: Use as context for a separately supported question. Do not train the model to impersonate the state using the monitor’s statements.
human_rights_evidence.scoring: Source attribution, factual consistency and temporal validity need review.
human_rights_evidence.possible_use: Retrieval / evidence-conditioned tasks after adding supported targets.

unverified_speech_segment.label: Speech segment with unverified boundaries
unverified_speech_segment.availability: Text exists; speaker attribution and segment boundaries are not confirmed.
input: meeting/document metadata; speaker identity must be checked
target: No verified target until speaker segmentation is resolved
unverified_speech_segment.inference: First extract a verified speaker turn. A file named after a country can still include other speakers.
unverified_speech_segment.scoring: Speaker and boundary verification is a prerequisite.
unverified_speech_segment.possible_use: Evidence discovery; not a ready country-specific supervised trace.

policy_evidence.label: Source document / evidence passage
policy_evidence.availability: Source evidence exists; a task and answer are not inherent in a document.
input: text / source passage, country or institution, policy date
target: A reviewed, source-grounded answer must be authored or selected
policy_evidence.inference: At inference: supply a dated passage and a specific policy question. Generate a supported answer, preserving conditions and uncertainty.
policy_evidence.scoring: Check exact source spans and institutional scope. The text itself is not an automatic reward function.
policy_evidence.possible_use: Retrieval first; evidence-conditioned SFT once targets exist; optional continued pretraining.

country_statistics.label: Country–indicator–year observation
country_statistics.availability: Structured values and missingness flags; not a conversational trace.
input: indicator definition, country, reference_year, unit and database vintage
value as evidence, unless that value is the prediction target
target: No policy-action target; a numeric extraction task could use value as the target
country_statistics.inference: At inference: use dated facts as context. For a numeric task, withhold the target from the input and preserve units and missingness.
country_statistics.scoring: Potential numeric/unit checks for newly constructed tasks. No RLVR task generator or evaluator is implemented.
country_statistics.possible_use: Structured retrieval; candidate factual extraction exercises, not a country-preference reward.

policy_applications.label: Authored evidence → policy answer
policy_applications.availability: Paired messages exist as review candidates; extension also has SFT export files.
input: messages[1]: institution/date, cited evidence and question
policy_applications.inference: At inference: supply a new question and dated evidence; generate a supported answer. Target text is authored, not an observed model answer.
policy_applications.scoring: rubric, source spans, scope and unsupported-claim checks. Review is pending; no automated correctness oracle.
policy_applications.possible_use: Evidence-conditioned SFT candidate; possible later preferences from reviewed errors.

policy_positions.label: Curated policy claim
policy_positions.availability: Attributed claim and source spans; not a complete dialogue.
input: claim plus source passages as dated context
target: No answer target in this claim record
policy_positions.inference: Use claims to assemble a dated dossier. Add a specific task and reviewed answer before supervised training.
policy_positions.scoring: Verify source support and scope; published policy does not establish behavior in every real project.
policy_positions.possible_use: Retrieval / dossier context; parent evidence for authored applications.

decision_cases.label: Proposal → vote + optional statement
decision_cases.availability: Joined retrospective cases; some explanation fields remain missing.
input: only information available before the vote for a forecasting task
target: attributed statement, where available and correctly classified, in a separate retrospective task
decision_cases.inference: At inference: predict a vote or explain a recorded decision, with these two tasks kept separate. Post-vote explanations leak the answer in a forecasting input.
decision_cases.scoring: Vote-label comparison plus evidence-based explanation review. No simulator, transitions or validated negotiation reward supplied.
decision_cases.possible_use: Supervised decision/explanation tasks after review; offline evaluation, not an interactive environment.

policy_evidence_document.label: Source document / evidence passage
policy_evidence_document.availability: Source evidence exists; a task and answer are not inherent in a document.
input: text / source passage, country or institution, policy date
target: A reviewed, source-grounded answer must be authored or selected
policy_evidence_document.inference: At inference: supply a dated passage and a specific policy question. Generate a supported answer, preserving conditions and uncertainty.
policy_evidence_document.scoring: Check exact source spans and institutional scope. The text itself is not an automatic reward function.
policy_evidence_document.possible_use: Retrieval first; evidence-conditioned SFT once targets exist; optional continued pretraining.

domain_text.label: Whole speech / domain text
domain_text.availability: Source text exists; no instruction–answer pair is inherent in the document.
input: country, speaker, event and language as attribution metadata
target: Next-token text continuation if used for continued pretraining; no separate assistant answer provided
domain_text.inference: Optional domain adaptation can train on text sequences. A dialogue task would require separate context and target construction.
domain_text.scoring: Language-model loss measures text prediction, not policy correctness or negotiation quality. Check attribution and held-out event overlap.
domain_text.possible_use: Retrieval or optional continued pretraining; construct and review tasks before SFT.
